title: Catalogue-distance annulus weighted by fault-zone complexity (analytic, terrain-free)
registered_before: building the surface or reading any HOLDOUT-DTI
lane_assignment_note: This session declares H79-STEP as its one lane and stays inside it. The active H79-NHR lane is stopped negative (duplicate gate) and is NOT restarted or retuned. H79-STEP uses only the pinned grid (existing_faults.tif + sample_submission.tif); no login-walled organizer training data is required.
hypothesis: Unmapped normal-fault strands (splays, step-over ramps, relay terminations) concentrate at the EDGES of mapped fault zones where the catalogue-distance field changes rapidly and the mapped network is locally complex, rather than immediately adjacent to single traces. An analytic surface that is high in the 200 m-2 km off-fault annulus AND in locally complex fault zones should rank hidden catalogue segments above uniform or single-distance surfaces, while occupying a different part of prediction space than the dense near-trace dot fields already in the registry.
mechanism: 1) D = Euclidean distance to the nearest mapped fault pixel (100 m grid). 2) Local fault-zone complexity = count of catalogue pixels in a 900 m (9 px) window. 3) Surface = annulus_window(D, 200 m-2 km) * complexity, rank-normalised to [0,1] over the footprint. 4) Dots emitted by fixed-budget 3 px Poisson spacing on surface > 0, zero on mapped faults and outside the footprint. Values exactly {0,1}. No DEM, no geophysics, no fitted model, no hidden labels enter the surface.
named_non_fault_process: Pluvial Lake Lahontan shoreline/terrace risers, incised channel banks, roads and mine benches can produce linear steps in the piedmont; these are not faults and are not in the catalogue, so they can mimic the surface but are scored as false positives by the holdout.
inputs: Pinned data/reference/existing_faults.tif (sha256 7ba308cc...): mapped USGS/INGENIOUS fault catalogue
Pinned data/reference/sample_submission.tif (sha256 2176d08e...): footprint, CRS EPSG:32611, 100 m transform

holdout.split: vendor/gems57 holdout.buffered_component_draw (whole components, buffer_px=3, boundary_px=12), seeds 20 and 30
holdout.masking: visible catalogue masked pixel-exactly; dots placed strictly off the mapped catalogue; surface analytic (no fitted model)
holdout.ci: paired percentile bootstrap over 20 km (200 px) blocks, 1000 draws

leakage_canary: Surface alone vs withheld positives (200k sampled negatives > 3 px from visible catalogue): symmetric AUC must be <= 0.90 on BOTH seeds, else STOP (protocol rule 4).

uniqueness_protocol.gates: Spearman <= 0.90 vs all registry rasters on the surface; forward 3 px overlap <= 0.70 vs every dot-field prior on the final dots; no byte/decoded identity with any prior
uniqueness_protocol.caveat: Registry rasters are not restored in this checkout (.cache/registry is empty), so the shared uniqueness gate cannot be executed locally; reported as NOT_CHECKED with reason, not cleared.

gates_to_promote_all_required: G1 canary: no symmetric AUC > 0.90 on either seed
G2 uniqueness attempted and honestly reported (NOT_CHECKED if registry unavailable)
G3 format: shared writer + on-disk validator PASS (single-band float32, EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, exact sample transform, all finite in [0,1], zero off-footprint and on catalogue)
G4 holdout measured: HOLDOUT-DTI + withheld count + paired 95% CI on both seeds
If any gate fails the verdict is negative / DO-NOT-SUBMIT; the negative result is the deliverable. No human inspection at any gate.
experiment_budget: max 3 experiments / 2 h. E1 = holdout seeds 20+30 + canary + format + uniqueness attempt. No hyper-parameter search.
score_labelling: Every number is HOLDOUT-DTI (evaluator gems57-pooled-hide-v2, withheld positives, 95% CI), REGISTRY-MEASUREMENT, or ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED (only a submission-page receipt; this repo has none). No projection is written as a score.
no_slot_selection: This pipeline never uploads and never chooses a weekly slot; verdict 'promote' means only that the separate selector may consider the file.
